question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correctly spelt word is 'Adaptation'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• From the given options, we need to select that word whose spelling is correct.
 
• **Adaptation** is the correctly spelt word and it is the physical characteristic of an organism that helps an organism to survive better in the surrounding environment
